subject: Private Offer: AWS EDU multi-year discount + rev-share reallocation request
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Wright <sara.wright@educonnect.org>, procurement@educonnect.org
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: AWS EDU multi-year discount + rev-share reallocation request

Hi Sara — great speaking earlier. Per our call, EduConnect is targeting a 3-year commitment across three regions (US primary, EU pilot, APAC optional) and requests a substantial academic discount to support campus adoption. To move forward quickly we can route this via an AWS Private Offer. Two points I promise to coordinate with our finance and marketplace teams: 

1) One-off EDU discount (list price -> 55% off for annual committed usage; blended price across years)
2) Marketplace rev-share reallocation: AWS standard rev-share for private offers is currently set at the publish rate; the customer is asking that Redwood accept a temporary rev-share adjustment for the first 12 months (proposed 70/30 favoring AWS in year 1, rolling to 80/20 in year 2-3).

Attached is a rough usage forecast and a proposed terms PDF. Can you please confirm the procurement timing and whether net60 payment and an academic PO are acceptable? If so, I'll escalate internally for executive concurrence on the non-standard rev-share/discount combination and request marketplace exception for the rev-share cadence.

Next steps I suggest: I loop in our Marketplace and Finance leads (cc'd) to confirm runway and any accounting implications, and we pull together a DocuSign-ready private offer once approvals are in place.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: EDU-usage-forecast.xlsx
Attachment: proposed-private-offer-terms.pdf

From: Sara Wright <sara.wright@educonnect.org>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@educonnect.org
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: AWS EDU multi-year discount + rev-share reallocation request

Hi Marcus — thanks for the summary and for the quick turnaround. Procurement confirms: net60 is fine, we will provide an academic PO from the central office. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The EDU discount needs to apply to all usage across our multiple subaccounts under one consolidated private offer.
- Our CFO is agreeable to the rev-share step-down plan as long as total effective cost of Redwood to EduConnect in year 1 is at or below $1.2M (our budget line).
- We prefer a single DocuSign envelope covering the 3-year term with an annual invoice schedule.

If you can get internal signoff on the rev-share reallocation and a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration costs, we can aim to sign within 10 business days.

Best,
Sara Wright
Director, Strategic Partnerships | EduConnect
sara.wright@educonnect.org

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private Offer: AWS EDU multi-year discount + rev-share reallocation request

Team — looping finance/marketplace leads and flagging this for exec approval. Summary of ask: 3-year commitment, EDU discount ~55%, year-1 rev-share move to 70/30 (AWS/Redwood) then normalize to 80/20 for years 2-3, net60, onboarding credit request. Customer target: <$1.2M effective spend in year 1. Attachments from Marcus included.

Key considerations: 
- Rev-share shift reduces Redwood take-rate materially in year 1; needs explicit approval from Revenue Ops and Sales Leadership for carveouts.
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit (up to $40k) funded from the sales incentives pool if Leadership approves.
- Marketplace listing: AWS requires private-offer alignment docs and Marketplace approval workflow (~3-5 business days once Legal signs).
- Accounting note: multi-year commitments with non-standard revenue splits can complicate ASC 606 recognition — finance must confirm deferral approach.

Requesting: Exec signoff from Markus or VP sales on (A) temporary rev-share reallocation for year 1, (B) approval of $40k onboarding credit, and (C) authorization to sign private offer with net60 and consolidated subaccount scope.

Can someone from Revenue Ops confirm if DL-7429 is within our quarterly quota leeway for one-off concessions?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer: AWS EDU multi-year discount + rev-share reallocation request (APPROVED)

Folks — after reviewing the summary and the forecast: approved with conditions. Approvals: 

1) Temporary rev-share reallocation for year 1 to 70/30 (AWS/Redwood) is approved for DL-7429 only, with automatic reversion to our standard 80/20 in year 2 and beyond.
2) One-time onboarding credit: approved up to $35,000 (final amount to be calibrated by Marissa with Sales Ops).
3) Net60 and consolidated subaccount private offer: approved.

Conditions: 
- Legal must include a clear clause in the private-offer that codifies the rev-share schedule and reversion trigger; Finance must confirm revenue recognition path before DocuSign is sent.
- Approval is conditional on HubSpot deal stage updated to "Exec Approved" and a signed PO uploaded to the deal record.
- This approval does not set precedent — any similar request requires a documented business rationale and VP-level signoff.

Marissa/Karthik — please prepare the marketplace submission and loop Legal/Finance. Marcus — coordinate with Sara to lock language and get the PO. I will sign the internal approval memo afterwards.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
